notes:
Android photo-picker compatibility. Handles photos returned in ClipData as well as the single data URI, including a single photo returned by a multiple-selection picker. Removes duplicate selections. Existing pending-unlock, timeout, screen-off and Friend-mode protections remain.

Only external content URIs are accepted; app-private providers and local-file/network URI fallbacks are rejected. No broad storage permission is added.

Android framework parser tests and grace-window tests pass, along with release compile/lint. Physical Android picker behavior is still unverified. Update over the existing app; do not uninstall.

Microphone handoff now retries while the unlocked web page finishes rendering, stays bounded by a timeout, clears cancelled requests and handles Android permission denial immediately. Android recording prefers WebM/Opus and tries another supported format if recorder construction fails. Microphone errors distinguish denied permission, busy microphone, missing microphone, interruption, constraints and recording format. Physical device behavior still needs confirmation.
